steps: Created own tab 1933378162 at the base URL, clicked Play and the visible Popular Kompally area. Loaded with 704 coins, Level 2 0/4, 2.5 s boost and 0 km/h. The initial loading placeholder wallet was not treated as a progress change.

Used Another twice and accepted Tasty Baite Bakers → Home in Doolapally, advertised 718 m, about 148 s and base 85 coins. Opened the map and clicked actual Close. The pickup approach HUD showed 374 m.

The initial route lay behind the vehicle. Short W+D steering moved off the lane toward building geometry and increased distance to 464–471 m. A second map inspection showed a westward then northward approach. Actual Close worked; R displayed Back to the street! and settled on a road around 371 m. This was an operator navigation correction, not an unreachable-pickup finding.

After a reverse attempt near another vehicle, pressed Space, held W+D for 2.1 s, then pressed Space again to cut flight. Visible elevated views included nearby buildings and lake; remaining charge was 0.4 s. Subsequent braking and reverse showed a street-level descent and distance near 340 m. Third map Close returned to gameplay.

Followed the visible route through narrow streets, with observed pickup distances 333, 308, 291, 278, 236, 201, 152, 148, 122, 121 and 83 m. An auto contact displayed Arre! Watch the auto! before collection. Ground travel recharged boost from 0.4 to 2.9 to 5.4 s.

Further short steering near 83 m departed the lane beside a purple facade and increased route distance to about 120 m. A second R displayed Back to the street! and glided to a usable street position, settling at 81 m and 0 km/h. This does not establish a facade-placement or navigation defect.

Continued the ground approach through 71, 43 and 28 m. Final short W+A steering and acceleration/braking reached 15 m and 0 km/h with Hold E / ACT to collect the pizza visible. Saved the original prompt screenshot.

Held E for 1.4 s. The explicit Pizza collected! Garam garam. toast appeared and the HUD changed to Deliver, Home in Doolapally, 767 m, 147 s and 100° heat. Saved the original collection screenshot. This confirms one actual pickup.

Pressed P and verified the final paused HUD: Home in Doolapally, 767 m, 140 s, 96° heat, 704 coins, Level 2 0/4, 7.9 s boost and 0 km/h. Marked the Kompally tab for handoff. No customer-leg driving or handover was attempted after collection.

Saved both originals through the local evidence form, closed both own temporary form tabs, and cleared screenshot byte variables. Own input lock was released at 18:38:41 UTC, 41 s after the nominal lease boundary while completing evidence saving. Parent was notified explicitly. ECIL and LB Nagar handoffs were re-marked earlier without resuming either game.
